tasks.title: Add rotation/size cap to roleiq.log
tasks.acceptance: The log handler is a RotatingFileHandler/TimedRotatingFileHandler with a stated size/backup-count policy.
tasks.evidence: PR #31, merged 1bc9793. roleiq.log now uses RotatingFileHandler, 5MB per file, 3 backups (~20MB ceiling).

tasks.title: Add a top-level exception hook so uncaught exceptions still reach roleiq.log, or explicitly accept the gap
tasks.acceptance: Either a verified top-level hook exists, or architecture.md/requirements.md records the decision to accept this gap with reasoning.
tasks.evidence: PR #32, merged 4d57907. Verified hook: Streamlit's script runner logs an uncaught top-level exception through streamlit.error_util, a logger Streamlit itself sets propagate=False on -- so root-logger handlers and sys.excepthook (never reached, Streamlit intercepts first) both missed it. Fixed by attaching app.py's RotatingFileHandler directly to that named logger. Confirmed via AppTest: message absent from roleiq.log before the fix, present after. Two committed regression tests (tests/test_uncaught_exception_logging.py).

tasks.title: Add a clean-install check to local CI (scripts/pre-push) so a requirements.txt regression can't pass silently
tasks.acceptance: scripts/pre-push fails if requirements-dev.txt can't resolve/install cleanly, verified by deliberately breaking a pin and confirming the hook catches it.
tasks.evidence: PR #33, merged e1c31e5. scripts/pre-push now runs `pip install --dry-run -r requirements-dev.txt` first. Verified by deliberately breaking pydantic's pin to a nonexistent version: hook failed and blocked (exit 1); restoring the pin passed cleanly.
